purpose: Validate minute-option schema and historical quality across three eras before purchasing a larger backtest dataset; no policy or P&L trial.

owner_credit_report.uncertainty: Owner said I think around; retain estimate, do not create verified credit evidence from it.

ceiling_origin: Agent-selected small pilot ceiling within existing owner frugal free-credit authorization; not an owner-specified amount or active runtime gate.
reservation_rule: Per job ceil(max(estimate*1.20,0.0001) to0.0001 USD); sum must remain<=0.50. All bounds re-quoted before submission.

boundaries.opening: Twenty-minute request envelope beginning09:30NewYork; modern first-ten-minute interval-end subset is09:30<label<=09:40. Preserve full sample.
boundaries.close_reference: 15:50–16:10NewYork envelope includes16:00label;16:00is underlying-session reference, not an assertion of options trading end.
boundaries.legacy: Pre2023-03-28timestamp override must be inspected separately; do not pretend true capture-clock evidence.

acceptance: Validate all vendor file hashes/sizes and exact request identity; retain private receipts and raw data.
Inventory records/columns/types, dated instrument mappings and definitions; do not use later definitions in earlier decisions.
Report all timestamp/flag patterns, missing intervals, missing/zero/crossed quotes and zero sizes.
Treat last-trade timestamps separately from quote update time; no five-second event freshness claim from minute snapshots.
Account for interval availability causally; flag publisher bit2 according to dated OPRA documentation; preserve bad-book and all unrelated flags.
Stop after quality report. No annual return, strategy selection or atomic fill claim.
before_acquisition: Implement and review separate CBBO-scoped batch operator and parser; legacy pilot/extension disallow this schema.
Keep existing verified-credit and durable reservation/uncertainty guards; current approximate report is planning evidence only.
Reconcile outstanding account usage and verify the exact current credit snapshot when a purchase is ready.
Ensure quoted reservations fit0.50; submit serially, persist intent beforePOST, never retry an unresolved submission.
